items.html: And that good mixed in them is what was clarified and turned in the secret of milk. For when it was within the dross, [the dross] multiplied over it and it was turned into blood; and now that it was clarified from them, it was turned into whiteness, which is its root. And the dross in them goes out in the secret of impure blood, after the completion of the two years of the Yenika — like the dross that did not go out until the completion of the time of the Ibur, in the secret of the blood of birth. So too this dross comes out of her after the completion of the time of the Yenika, when there is no longer in it anything to clarify that would be fit to make from it the aspect of ZON that is in Atzilut, as above, how they too return to be clarified for the need of the world of Beria.
